mapper.select: SELECT trip_id, member_id, title, start_date, end_date FROM trips WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT trip_id, member_id, title, start_date, end_date FROM trips WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT report_id, trip_id, generation_status, locale FROM reports WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY report_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.item_id, ti.visit_date, ei.item_type, COALESCE(e.title, p.name) AS title, ti.trip_item_status AS status FROM trip_items ti JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = ti.item_id AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.event_id IS NOT NULL) OR (ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.place_id IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY ti.visit_date ASC, ti.display_order ASC, ti.trip_item_id ASC
mapper.sql: t.transfer_id, le.ledger_entry_id, le.amount, DATE(t.completed_at) AS occurred_on, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.spending_category, ''), 'OTHER') AS category, t.memo
mapper.select: SELECT , CASE WHEN tel.trip_id = #{tripId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS selected FROM wallet_ledger_entries le JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = le.transfer_id JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = le.wallet_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN wallet_owners wo ON wo.wallet_owner_id = w.wallet_owner_id AND wo.member_id = #{memberId} AND wo.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN trips tr ON tr.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tr.member_id = #{memberId} AND tr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN trip_expense_links tel ON tel.ledger_entry_id = le.ledger_entry_id WHERE le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.currency_code = 'KRW' AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.transfer_type IN ('QR_PAYMENT', 'SETTLEMENT') AND DATE(t.completed_at) BETWEEN tr.start_date AND tr.end_date AND ( tel.ledger_entry_id IS NULL OR (tel.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tel.deleted_at IS NULL) ) ORDER BY t.completed_at ASC, t.transfer_id ASC
SELECT ledger_entry_id FROM trip_expense_links WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ledger_entry_id ASC
SELECT trip_id FROM trip_expense_links WHERE ledger_entry_id = #{ledgerEntryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (trip_id, generation_status, locale, report_content, generated_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{generationStatus}, #{locale}, #{reportContent, typeHandler=me.nawa.explore.mapper.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.trip_id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date, t.end_date, r.generation_status, r.locale, r.report_content, r.generated_at, r.created_at FROM reports r JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = r.trip_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.report_id, r.trip_id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date, t.end_date, r.generation_status, r.locale, r.generated_at, r.created_at FROM reports r JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = r.trip_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.report_id DESC
SELECT member_id, display_name, profile_image_url, nationality_code FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, m.display_name, m.profile_image_url, m.nationality_code FROM ( SELECT ti.appointment_id FROM trip_items ti WHERE ti.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ti.trip_item_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND ti.appointment_id IS NOT NULL AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL UNION SELECT am.appointment_id FROM appointment_members am WHERE am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.trip_id = #{tripId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ) mine JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = mine.appointment_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.appointment_status != 'CANCELLED' JOIN appointment_members am2 ON am2.appointment_id = a.appointment_id AND am2.member_id != #{memberId} AND am2.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am2.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN members m ON m.member_id = am2.member_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.member_id ASC
mapper.sql: FROM wallet_ledger_entries le JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = le.transfer_id JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = le.wallet_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN wallet_owners wo ON wo.wallet_owner_id = w.wallet_owner_id AND wo.member_id = t.initiator_member_id AND wo.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.currency_code = 'KRW' AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.transfer_type IN ('QR_PAYMENT', 'SETTLEMENT') AND DATE(t.completed_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
mapper.select:
SELECT t.initiator_member_id AS member_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.spending_category, ''), 'OTHER') AS category, SUM(le.amount) AS amount
AND t.initiator_member_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY t.initiator_member_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.spending_category, ''), 'OTHER') ORDER BY t.initiator_member_id ASC, amount DESC, category ASC

SELECT ranked.member_id, ranked.analytics FROM ( SELECT t.member_id, JSON_EXTRACT(r.report_content, '$.analytics') AS analytics, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.member_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.report_id DESC ) AS rn FROM reports r JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = r.trip_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN members m ON m.member_id = t.member_id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.generation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.nationality_code = #{nationalityCode} AND m.member_id != #{memberId} AND m.account_type = 'TRAVELER' ) ranked WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ORDER BY ranked.member_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
